def generate_from_lcf(lcf, n):
    """Generate graph from LCF notation."""
    edges = set()
    for i in range(n):
        for offset in lcf:
            j = (i + offset) % n
            if i < j:
                edges.add((i, j))
            else:
                edges.add((j, i))
    return sorted(edges)
